blocks.text: AI-powered interactive product demos in minutes

Supademo captures your product workflow as a series of screenshots and automatically generates interactive, step-by-step demos. Click through your product, and Supademo creates an annotated walkthrough that anyone can follow - no sandbox accounts or live demos required.

The AI assistance accelerates demo creation. After capturing screenshots, AI generates descriptions for each step, suggests hotspot placements, and creates a coherent narrative flow. What would take an hour to build manually takes minutes with Supademo's AI.

For product-led growth teams, Supademo serves multiple use cases: marketing demos on landing pages, onboarding walkthroughs for new users, training material for features, and sales enablement content for prospects. One demo creation workflow produces assets for multiple teams.
Record your product flow and auto-generate interactive demos
AI generates step descriptions and tooltip content
Add voiceover to demos for a guided experience
Track demo views, completion rates, and step engagement
Embed in websites, help docs, emails, and Notion pages
Supademo produces interactive demos faster than any alternative we have tested. The AI annotations mean you get a polished result without manually writing every tooltip and description.
Our team can integrate Supademo into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
